 The Police-Inspector of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 to 4 for the offences punishable U/s.498A r/w/s 34 of IPC.
 2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Sushma S.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 10-05- 2012.
After the marriage, the accused No.2 to 4 with common intention used to quarrel with CW-1 for petty matters.
The accused No.2 to 4 used to instigate accused No.1.

The accused No.1 used to  3  C.C.No.15619/2021 harass CW-1 to get additional dowry from her maternal house,
when CW-1 had gone to her maternal house, the accused No.1 had pledged the gold ornaments of CW-1 worth of Rs.10 lakhs without the knowledge of CW-1 and when CW 1 to 4 questioned regarding the same, the accused No.2 has abused her in filthy language.
The accused No.4 has assaulted CW-1 and on 05-01-2020 the accused No.1 to 4 assaulted CW-1, dragged her and her children out of the house and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.

Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.25/2021 came to Sushma S vs Pramod on 9 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75023998/

On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

sentences.text:
The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and thereby accused have committed the offences  punishable U/s.498A r/w/s 34 of IPC. ?
 2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 5  C.C.No.15619/2021  REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex . P.2
is the spot panchanama.
was examined as PW-1 Smt. Sushma.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused was performed on 10-05-2012 and deposed after the marriage,
accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and deposed accused did not threatened her. PW-1
deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.

PW-1 identified Sushma S vs Pramod on 9 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75023998/
4 Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2(a) and she pleaded her ignorance about the  6  C.C.No.15619/2021 contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-
